name: パルコ デッラ パーチェ (PARCO della PACE)
gf_detail: No gluten-free offering documented. This is a wheat-flour pizzeria; the standard pizza crusts are wheat-based and no GF crust or GF menu was found. Not suitable for strict gluten-free diners.

name: ビーガン フルーツカフェ タマル 紙屋町店 (Vegan Fruits Cafe Tamaru Kamiyacho)
cuisine: All-vegan fruit cafe: fruit parfaits, vegan
neighborhood: Kamiyachō / Hondori, Naka-ku, central Hiroshima (near A-Bomb
gf_detail: No gluten-free information is documented on any available source. The menu centers on fruit-forward vegan items (parfaits, oatmeal, smoothies) that may suit gluten-avoidant diners, but sandwiches and toast use bread, and there is no stated GF preparation or cross-contamination control. A traveler with celiac disease should ask in person.

name: カフェ レンテ (Cafe Lente)
cuisine: Cafe / light meals. Organic blend coffee, house-made cheesecake, tomato curry
neighborhood: Miyajima (Itsukushima Shrine area, Kita-onishi; about a 15-min walk from the Miyajima pier, near the exit of the Five-Storied Pagoda and Itsukushima Shrine)
gf_detail: A rice-based "red-rice and spinach soy-milk risotto" is introduced as gluten-free and noted by several outlets as popular with foreign tourists. name: 桂愛 (Keiai)
neighborhood: Nakamachi, Naka Ward (Hondori, near Fukuromachi tram stop)
gf_detail: Not gluten-free oriented. Documented dishes (soy-sauce ramen, gyoza, soy-meat karaage, mapo tofu over rice) typically involve wheat via noodles, dumpling skins, batter, regular soy sauce, and wheat-gluten soy meat. A GF diner must ask; no GF accommodation is documented.

name: 一楽章　未完成 (Ichigakusho Mikansei)
neighborhood: Kamiyacho, Naka Ward (~2 min walk from Kamiyacho-higashi Stn, very close to Hondori / Peace Memorial Park)
gf_detail: No gluten-free claims are documented anywhere. The curry roux is made without oil but there is no information confirming it is wheat-free, and Japanese curry roux commonly contains wheat flour as a thickener. A gluten-free traveler would need to ask directly about each dish; treat as not confirmed GF.

gf_detail: Not gluten-free. The baked goods are made with domestic wheat flour (国産小麦粉), so muffins and scones contain gluten. The shop focuses on egg/dairy/white-sugar avoidance, not gluten avoidance.
